description: Harendra Tau took a fierce class of BJP leaders on the rising prices of petrol and diesel. #FarmersprotestViralvideo #politalks #harendrachachanews #PetroLDIELPRICEHEKE

asr.full_text: People have been saying this for decades like who've committed violence. You still can't remember her name. Kejriwal Ji has claimed that Delhi's Chief Minister is responsible for violence and it's the Govt. That's what they said. Delhi's Chief Minister is not being able to do it. The people who want to become politicians should get out of the army. We are all farmers. Our government's responsibility is that we do this. For example, farmers of this particular area have asked people to sell milk at least for Rs.100 per kg, which will be sold in a single match. This is our money, whether we are able to sell it or not, what pressure should we put on anybody? So if we sell our petrol at any rate or not, why are you saying that? Tell the government that it is the government's petrol! They say that we don't have any control over it! And they increase the rate! If we increase the rate of milk, the people won't have any problem! What will happen? Who will buy 100 rupees a liter of milk? When Ramdev sells 90 rupees a liter used in the cow's bathroom and the people of the country support him and are BJP supporters, people who support him, drink milk in a 90 rupees a liter bottle. And the one who is the support of BJP DrINKS THAT BANANA LITTLE BUNNY FROM 90 RUPE So I'm selling those cow's milk And amrit We take revenge WHY Even the milk is our And the cow breast is also ours Even those meaty cows have variety Like the pathenjali You think I'm some good Pakistani Ramdeen ...they are being called the patriots, the self-proclaimers who oppose them. What Pakistani did we come of? Mohod Lagri? Ramdev came of from? Mohod Lagri got a new position. After this you talk. Yes, yes tell me. So what dairy farm does the Ramdev come from? It just goes for milk business. He makes this whole thing into fake milk and sends it to you. Show her just how little the real milk she has at hand. He has gone around selling fake milk. Just see what the milk production is like in India! If you provide 100 litre petrol while you are selling milk, then where will the public go? How will people lose their livelihood? Then what are you fighting about? We believe government is selling the wheat at Rs.100 per kgs. We are saving the population from starvation. It will cost Rs. 135 per kgs. Arvind Kejriwal, you may know, has a very famous face. All he said was... These are three laws laws are death warranty We have been telling this to him since earlier days, Arvind Kejriwal How the hell do not tell us this? Why did the government say this after 3 months? I don't care if these politicians are dead or not, I am dead Tell me What do you mean by I don't care? I am talking about farmers! We are talking to the Prime Minister! The if any one of you is the Minister of Agriculture then we should put a verdict from there Why she is saying that always? I'm coming to ask from God Why do farmer must put a verdict? All we should do is hang them We'll let them not say to die Then all farmers die Then what will we rule on? They will do nothing because everyone will die we will rule only in our houses tiket sahab wants a group of people coming and will start destroying the Godan of Abani Adani tiket sahab has no order, don't spread lie tiket sahab has never said this who has shown this to him you show me any of this This is an bad news rakesh tikat ji has only said this no, he hasn't said this and if they have if they have I have nothing to ask. Didn't Rakeshti Kherji say this? No, not Rakeshti? And if she does, then I have NO piece of information! What are you going to say on Kangana's tweets?! I won't. As they are older. Ok, uncle. We went to the Maha Panchayat. A senior journalist from the National Media came on the stage. He resigned himself. What will you say? Yes were present there? Yes I was there Yes And when that journalist said that he would be coming to do a cover to this huge panchayat He sent one word of his right to me He came to one of the journalist who was from ABP News Please try to recognize your and also salute the journalist who put future? What? Won't you salute the media? I am just saying at least the media! The person have sent me here. They told me to do reporting like in the rally in Chennai That this rally want to be a flop rally What do you want sir? What do you want? But they didn't had a channel not media What is the channel's boldness to do that? Every morning one system will be set by the government That, This Agenda will continue for the rest of the day That, Today there won't be any conversation between farmers It's all about Pakistan It's all about America Bangal Everything will be talked about If you want to think about China & Pakistan.. the America, the Bengal, the whole world. The prime minister wants Pakistan to see their families with white eyes Which day have we seen the eyes of? Just tell me one day has anyone ever seen their relatives with white eyes? Or have anyone ever asked them to get a Saree for their mother's sake... or for their Mother's sake. Who got this app boycotted? This app is China's. China... Boycotted by the young people. From where you are, you go from here. The rail that is being constructed from Delhi to Mirat, the trains that are being constructed, someone gives them to China. These are rapid rail trains. You are giving Chyna a deal. And she is that Prime Minister! She was the Prime Minister until today who kept Chyna's banks out of India ... While she was in power, she also opened Chyna's bank in Mumbai. Bank of Chhine, it doesn't go under Indian rule, and with them, They opened Bank of Bimabai, also Our enemies were with them, and they even treated them a tea I could see 40,000 tractors coming, but couldn't find them There was no call. I don't know when, but if I see the date. I will give you an idea, as soon as we write the dates, we shall count the border at every second, we'll have 1,400,000 and it will be less than 1 lakh. And they are preparing to gather the court, right? Yes, they are going to.

textual.observation: A speaker alleges that Ramdev's milk business makes, sends, and sells “fake milk.”

evidence.quote: So what dairy farm does the Ramdev come from? It just goes for milk business.
He makes this whole thing into fake milk and sends it to you.
He has gone around selling fake milk.

textual.context: Critical discussion/accusation within political commentary; no observed purchase link, contact method, payment request, or call for viewers to buy in the supplied records.
textual.potential_relevance: The cited relationship is a claim that a named person/business sends and sells milk described as fake to consumers; this could be relevant for later context assessment of alleged product misrepresentation, without establishing whether the claim is true.
textual.limitations: The source records do not establish whether any milk is fake, the exact product involved, any transaction destination, consumer outcome, or speaker intent; ASR may contain mistakes.

textual_context_notes.observation: The description frames the video as political commentary about BJP leaders and rising fuel prices.

evidence.quote: Harendra Tau took a fierce class of BJP leaders on the rising prices of petrol and diesel.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents political commentary about farmers, fuel prices, government responsibility, and related claims, with the speaker addressing microphones rather than promoting a commercial opportunity. The claim that Ramdev’s milk is fake is framed as criticism, not a request for viewers to buy or pay for anything. The allegations remain unverified, and the transcription may contain errors.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central observed content is a general political discussion about farmers, government responsibility and petrol prices, rather than a commercial or financial participation offer.

evidence.observation: The speaker identifies with farmers and discusses government responsibility.
evidence.quote: We are all farmers. Our government's responsibility is that we do this.

evidence.observation: The speaker criticizes claims about control over petrol pricing.
evidence.quote: So if we sell our petrol at any rate or not, why are you saying that? Tell the government that it is the government's petrol! They say that we don't have any control over it! And they increase the rate!

evidence.observation: A man in a white scarf appears with several microphones in front of him and other people nearby, within a news-style video border.
The speaker alleges that another person has sold fake milk; the allegation is not independently established.
evidence.quote: He has gone around selling fake milk.
